content:
Charity = \(10\%\) of total monthly production = \(0.10 \times 36{,}500 = 3{,}650\).

Neighbor = \(6\%\) of annual donuts = \(0.06 \times 36{,}500 = 2{,}190\).

Remaining donuts:
\[
36{,}500 - 1{,}460 - 720 - 3{,}650 - 2{,}190 = 28{,}480
\]

Full boxes:
\[
\left\lfloor \frac{28{,}480}{50} \right\rfloor = 569
\]

\boxed{569}
